evidence.limits: No transcript after about 6 minutes of waiting; speech is coded from burned-in captions only (hook captions complete at 4 fps, later ones sampled once a second so words are missing around 5-6 s, 10-11 s and 23-24 s). Who speaks (Matan as voiceover) is inferred, he never appears on camera. Location is inferred from a staff shirt reading 'KOTOR', a sign 'Alpine Coaster' and commenters, not stated by him. Sound effects not determinable. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Time is worth more than money: a fast-track queue at an alpine coaster saves 'an hour and twenty', and ordinary people (called 'tourist employees') choose to wait.
audience: Israeli viewers who travel and queue; salaried people are named as the foil ('תיירים שכירים'); his followers.
caption_vs_video_note: Matches: the caption says time matters more than money, and mentions the price gap between a regular and fast ticket. The caption adds the claim that people do not learn this lesson and that the price gap was 'a joke', which the video does not show.

opening.first_frame: A phone-shot long queue of tourists outside a white building at sunset; no text yet.
opening.s0_1: Handheld pan along the queue; big white caption words appear: 'כל' (0.25 s), 'אלה' (0.75 s).
opening.s1_3: Caption 'עומדים בתור' (1.0-2.0 s); at 2.2 s cut to a second queue seen from behind, caption 'מה באמת עוקף את' (about 2.5-3.5 s).
opening.s3_5: Same shot: 'כולם עכשיו?' (3.75-4.25 s) then 'זה' at 4.75 s; shot moves toward the head of the queue.
opening.visual_hook: A long real queue of strangers, handheld, then the camera walks past it.
opening.spoken_hook: Spoken from 0 s (machine transcript): 'כל אלה עומדים בתור' (0 to 1.8 s), then a question at 2.4 s (wording garbled, caption: 'מה באמת עוקף את כולם עכשיו?'), answered by a second voice 'זה... נקרא פסט טרק' at 4.8 s.
opening.text_hook: כל אלה עומדים בתור / מה באמת עוקף את כולם עכשיו?
opening.works_without_sound: yes: large word-by-word captions carry the whole argument.

visual.subject_placement: Phone POV walking along a queue; subjects (strangers) are at the centre or in the background, captions centred over the lower middle of the frame.
visual.setting: A theme-park style alpine coaster entrance: cobbled paths, a blue 'FAST TRACK' lane painted next to the green regular lane, red rope stanchions, turnstiles with a ticket scanner, staff in white polo shirts, a final POV of the coaster track in the mountains.
visual.lighting: Natural light, sunset at the start, daylight afterwards.
visual.color_contrast: Strong blue and green lane colours against grey stone; white captions with black outline.
visual.props_and_gestures: Ticket held in a hand at 5 s and 28-30 s; an attendant scans tickets; the POV at 33-34 s shows legs on the coaster car.
visual.supporting_footage: None: the whole Reel is one continuous handheld visit with several jump cuts.
visual.faces_blurred: no (tourists and staff, including a young person at 25 s, are identifiable)
visual.visual_progression: 0-2 first queue at sunset; 2.2-7.3 s second queue and a ticket in hand; 7.3-25 s walking beside the blue Fast Track lane past the waiting queue; 25 s close shot of two tourists holding tickets; 27-32 s turnstile and attendant, 'THANKS'; 32 s man in front of an 'Alpine Coaster' sign; 33-35 s POV ride down the track.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: the cover is the 15 s shot of waiting people with the caption word 'זה' (the video's own frame).
visual.ui_interference: Captions are mid-frame (about 50 to 55 percent down), clear of the overlay zones; the small yellow aside at 17-21 s sits near 55 percent.

editing.edit_function: Cuts at 2.2, 7.3, 25.2 and 32.9 s (ffmpeg) move from queue to lane to staff to ride; the main stimulation is the word-by-word captions, one word per beat, mostly in a heavy white outlined font.
pacing_changes: t=0-5 s: one new word every 0.25-0.5 s
t=7-23 s: slower, longer pauses, one to two words per second over a walk along the lane
t=33-35 s: no captions, ride POV
editing.ending: At 32.9 s a POV ride down the track; no caption or spoken closing line is visible in the last 3 s (loudness rises to about -12 dB).
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: low; the satisfaction of the ride at the end and the argument are one-time. Shares are high instead (1,973).

sound.delivery: Machine transcript shows a quiet question and answer exchange from 0 to about 24 s (two voices, short lines of 1 to 3 s, brief gaps 1.8 to 2.4 s, 6.3 to 7.3 s, 14 s, 16 to 17 s, 17.4 to 18.8 s); the low loudness in 2 to 5 s still carries speech. After 24 s transcript unclear (only 'תודה רבה' printed at 30 to 33 s, which usually means no clear speech).
sound.music: unclear (no lyrics printed; 'תודה רבה' at 30 to 33 s hints at non-speech audio there)
sound.sync: Captions follow the spoken lines in the first 24 s; later sync cannot be checked (transcript unclear after 24 s).

text.colour_coding: White outlined words for the main speech; small yellow parenthetical for an aside ('זה חוסך שעה ועשרים' at 17-21 s) and the yellow line 'תיירים שכירים' (25-26 s).
text.placement: Centre of the frame, a bit below the middle.
text.style: Very heavy white rounded sans-serif with a thick black stroke; the English words 'TRACK' and 'THANKS' use a bolder Latin face; size changes per word.
text.density_and_read_time: 1-2 words at a time; trivially quick to read; about 35 captured words in 35 s.
text.relation_to_speech: verbatim in 0 to 24 s (checked against the machine transcript); unclear after 24 s
text.language: Short ironic phrases: 'תיירים שכירים', 'אה וואו', 'אווי', 'מתעדפים'; a spoken aside in brackets with a concrete number ('שעה ועשרים').
text.caption_structure: Cap opens with a values statement about teaching children that time is worth more than money, then a judgement on people who prefer saving money to saving time ('הדבר המטומטם ביותר'), and a closing detail about the small price gap. Emojis ❗️ and 🤦‍♂️; no hashtags, no CTA; caption edited.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew and English 'FAST TRACK', 'TRACK', 'THANKS' mix fine; the on-screen word order is correct; the parenthetical text ends with a closing bracket on the left side.

story.stakes: Hours of life spent waiting, framed as 'time' against 'money'.
story.progression: Question about who skips the queue, walk past the queue on the Fast Track lane, an aside that it saves 'an hour and twenty', then a short reading of the queue as 'tourist employees', then a staff ticket check and a ride.
story.payoff: The coaster ride itself (33-35 s) and the quantified saving.
story.resolution: Not stated in words visible after 26 s.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: the ride is shown, but the answer to 'what really skips the queue' rests on caption words that were not all caught
friction_points: t=5-6 s and 10-12 s: some caption words missed, so the argument is partly unverified
t=13-23 s: long slow walk past people with few captions (interpretation: slowest part, but shows the real queue)

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 41, not representative. Many are arguments about the 'שכירים' label ('לבוא ולהתנשא שהם שכירים לא לעניין'), people telling their own fast-track stories, asking where it is ('איפה זה?', 'באיזה פארק זה?'). The creator did not ask for any action.

conversion.proof: own footage of the queue and lane

rights_and_privacy: No third-party footage, music not determined. Identifiable tourists, a minor-looking person at 25 s and staff filmed without blur (yes): limits reuse in a kids-product context.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a clear, visual mystery (everyone waits, one lane does not) with a quantified payoff ('שעה ועשרים'), a controversial label ('תיירים שכירים') that provokes an argument (14 of 41 sampled comments disagree) and a high share rate (2.26 per 1k views).
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: low-density story and no CTA; the ending is only a ride clip.

standout_moments.what: Word-by-word caption starts on frame one over a real queue: topic clear without any intro.
The blue 'FAST TRACK' lane painted beside the green one visualises the claim with no explanation.
Yellow caption 'תיירים שכירים' over two tourists holding tickets, the line commenters argue about.
Spoken question 'time or money, which matters more to you?' (machine transcript) frames the fast lane as a choice
Spoken answer: people who queue prioritize money over time (machine transcript)
